title: Tributary topic name, v0
description: Validates a single topic name string. See README.md section 1 for the grammar.

consumerGroup.description: tb.<env>.<channel>.<role>[.<destination>][.shadow-<label>], or (set 1.8) the environment-wide platform group tb.<env>.archiver

anyOf.$comment: Set 1.8. The archiver consumes _tb.<env>.events for every channel, so its group has no channel segment. Its ACL is LITERAL: a PREFIXED tb.<env>.archiver grant would also match the groups of a channel named 'archiver' (tb.<env>.archiver.pipeline).
